intent: Individually authored grouped-unit, directed quarter-turn, exact/approximate count and ordinal paragraph tasks. Guided practice only; no independent or hearing credit.
picturePurpose: An exact code-drawn arrow supplies the directed quarter-turn task. Numbered scales, counts and paragraphs come from authored data.

workshop.title: 核对单位、方向和数值范围
workshop.instruction: 先摆组数、圈记录、转箭头，再把目标词填回原例句。

items.label: sixty：秒数和分钟数分开
items.prompt: A clean-up timer runs for 180 seconds. Each whole-minute card represents sixty seconds. How many cards match the time?

wordDecision.prompt: A clean-up timer runs for 180 seconds. Each whole-minute card represents sixty seconds. How many cards match the time?

quantity.title: 摆出完整的一分钟卡
quantity.hint: 每张卡代表60秒，也就是完整的一分钟。
quantity.wrong: 一百八十秒是三分钟，应摆3张一分钟卡。

items.material: There are sixty seconds in a minute.
items.reason: sixty是60，sixteen是16。one minute等于sixty seconds；一百八十秒除以每分钟六十秒，是三分钟。图中每张卡代表完整一分钟，不是一秒。

options.reason: 一张卡六十秒，一百八十秒是三分钟。
六十是一分钟的秒数，不是本次需要的分钟卡数。
sixteen是十六，与sixty所表示的六十不同。

items.label: seventy：路线总长与还剩几步
items.prompt: A route is seventy steps long. Twenty steps are already walked. Each card stands for ten steps. How many cards remain?

wordDecision.prompt: A route is seventy steps long. Twenty steps are already walked. Each card stands for ten steps. How many cards remain?

quantity.title: 只摆剩余的十步卡
quantity.hint: 每张卡代表10步；这里只摆还没走的部分。
quantity.wrong: 还剩五十步，每张卡十步，共5张。

items.material: My grandfather walks seventy steps to the shop.
items.reason: seventy表示70，seventeen表示17。先算70−20=50步，再按每张卡十步换成五张卡。原例句说到商店的总步数，仍填seventy。

options.reason: 七张是整条七十步路线，没有扣掉已经走过的二十步。
seventeen是十七；题目中的seventy表示七十。
七十步走了二十步，还剩五十步，是五张十步卡。

items.label: eighty：明信片张数与文件夹数
items.prompt: We have eighty postcards. Each folder holds twenty postcards. How many folders hold the whole collection?

wordDecision.prompt: We have eighty postcards. Each folder holds twenty postcards. How many folders hold the whole collection?

quantity.title: 摆出装明信片的文件夹
quantity.hint: 每张卡代表一个文件夹；每个文件夹装20张。
quantity.wrong: 八十张每二十张一组，需要4个文件夹。

items.material: The collection contains eighty local postcards.
items.reason: eighty是80，不写成eightty；eighteen是18。每个文件夹二十张，用80÷20=4，得到四个文件夹。卡片在这里表示整个文件夹，不表示单张明信片。

options.reason: 八十是明信片张数，不能直接当作文件夹数。
八十张，每个文件夹二十张，共四个文件夹。
eighteen表示十八，eighty表示八十。

items.label: ninety：向左四分之一圈
items.prompt: The paper arrow points up. Turn it ninety degrees to the left. Which direction should it point?

wordDecision.prompt: The paper arrow points up. Turn it ninety degrees to the left. Which direction should it point?

rotation.title: 按要求转动纸上的箭头
rotation.hint: 从向上开始，向左转四分之一圈。
rotation.wrong: 九十度是四分之一圈；向左转后应指向左方。

items.material: Turn the paper ninety degrees to the left.
items.reason: ninety是90，nineteen是19。ninety degrees是四分之一圈；题目还要求to the left。起点向上，向左转九十度后指向左，不能只看角度而漏掉方向。
items.hint: up → a quarter turn left → left。

options.reason: 从上方向左转四分之一圈，箭头指向左方。
这是从上方向右转九十度；题目要求向左。
从上转到下需要半圈一百八十度，不是九十度。

items.label: hundred：确切数目后不加s
items.prompt: A verified count records exactly 300 birds. Which phrase gives that exact number?

wordDecision.prompt: A verified count records exactly 300 birds. Which phrase gives that exact number?

recordSelection.title: 圈出要核对的确切计数
recordSelection.prompt: 只圈实际计数，不圈笼统描述。
recordSelection.hint: Exactly给确切数，about保留估计语气。
recordSelection.wrong: 应圈Exactly 300 birds；其余说法都没有给出同样的确切计数。

items.material: About a hundred birds gathered on the roof.
items.reason: 具体数目three后用hundred，不加s，也不接of：three hundred birds。hundreds of birds表示数以百计，不能精确代替300。原例句about a hundred表示大约一百，about保留估计语气。
items.hint: exactly 300 → three hundred birds；hundreds of是概数。

options.reason: 具体数字three后hundred不加s。
hundreds of表示数以百计，没有给出确切的三百只。
three后用hundred原形，表示确切的三百只。

items.label: thousand：将近一千，还没到一千
items.prompt: The visitor counter shows 980. Which phrase describes the count accurately?

wordDecision.prompt: The visitor counter shows 980. Which phrase describes the count accurately?

items.material: Nearly a thousand people visited the exhibition.
items.reason: thousand表示一千。nearly a thousand表示将近一千，还没有达到一千；more than a thousand表示超过一千。具体数字后不加s，如two thousand；thousands of才表示数以千计。

options.reason: exactly表示恰好一千，与记录的九百八十不符。
九百八十接近一千，但还没有到一千。
more than表示超过一千，九百八十还不到一千。

items.label: million：超过一百万，恰好不算超过
items.prompt: Circle only survey records that support more than a million trees. Check each written count.

wordDecision.prompt: Circle only survey records that support more than a million trees. Check each written count.

recordSelection.title: 圈出严格超过一百万的记录
recordSelection.prompt: 逐条读数字；恰好一百万不算超过。
recordSelection.hint: more than是严格大于；不是at least。

items.material: The city has more than a million trees.
items.before: The city has more than a
items.reason: a million是1,000,000。more than a million必须大于一百万，恰好一百万不算超过。two million不加s；millions of表示数以百万计。树木总数看书面调查记录；不能把达到一百万误当作超过。
items.hint: more than 1,000,000 → only 1,000,001 in these records。

options.reason: more than不包括恰好一百万。
九十九万九千九百九十九还没有达到一百万。
一百万零一超过一百万；恰好一百万和九十九万九千九百九十九都不符合。

items.label: first：找第一段，不是最后一段
items.prompt: The notice asks you to read the first paragraph. Which paragraph should you open before answering?

wordDecision.prompt: The notice asks you to read the first paragraph. Which paragraph should you open before answering?

recordSelection.title: 圈出便条的第一段
recordSelection.prompt: 只圈题目要求先读的那一段。

rows.label: Paragraph 1
rows.text: The exhibition opens at ten on Saturday.

rows.label: Paragraph 2
rows.text: Bring your collection folder to the hall.

rows.label: Paragraph 3
rows.text: Ask the student guides if you need help.

recordSelection.hint: 按1、2、3的顺序找第一段，不按句子长短猜。

items.material: Read the first paragraph before answering.
items.reason: first是序数词，表示第一；the first paragraph中的the通常不能漏。先找段落顺序，再读这一段。first不等于last；在本题三段便条中，最后一段是第三段。
items.hint: first → paragraph 1；顺序由便条中的段落编号给出。

options.reason: first表示第一，对应从上到下的第一段。
第二段是second paragraph，不是first。
第三段在这份三段便条中是最后一段，不是第一段。

transfer.passage:
EXHIBITION HELPERS — PREPARATION NOTE
Paragraph 1: The exhibition opens at ten on Saturday. Read this paragraph before answering the opening-time question.
Paragraph 2: We have eighty postcards, with twenty in each folder. The visitor counter shows 980.
Paragraph 3: Bring the folders to the hall and ask the guides if you need help.

options.text: We need four folders, and nearly a thousand visitors have arrived.
We need eighty folders, and nearly a thousand visitors have arrived.
We need four folders, and exactly a thousand visitors have arrived.
We need four folders, and more than a thousand visitors have arrived.

answer.display: We need four folders, and nearly a thousand visitors have arrived.

explanation.strategy: 先用每组容量求文件夹数，再保留nearly所表示的范围。

steps.text: 八十张明信片，每个文件夹二十张，需要80÷20=4个。
steps.reason: 八十是明信片张数，不能直接当作文件夹数。

steps.text: 记录为980，接近但未到1,000，应说nearly a thousand。
steps.reason: exactly表示恰好，more than表示超过，都不符合九百八十。

distractors.reason: 八十是明信片张数；每二十张一组，文件夹只需四个。

explanation.pitfall: 单位换组不能漏；nearly、exactly和more than不能互换。

visual.title: 组数与人数范围分别核对
visual.caption: 先核对单位，再保留原记录给出的数值范围。
